headers.comment: CSS and JS carry a ?v=<content hash> so the URL changes whenever the file does. That is what makes an immutable year-long cache safe here — a deploy produces a new URL rather than a stale cache. See assetHash in eleventy.config.js.
Fonts, images and icons are versioned by filename — hero-tradie-900.webp, inter-latin.woff2. Changing one means a new name, so these are safe to cache hard.
og-image and favicon are fetched by social platforms and browsers that ignore query strings. A week is long enough to matter, short enough to recover from a bad share card.

HTML, sitemap, robots and llms.txt must stay revalidated — content changes and search engines should see it immediately. Vercel's default is already correct for these; stated explicitly so nobody widens the rule above by accident.
